EXTRACTION RECON (Book #10) is the tenth book in an exhilarating new action thriller series from the #1 bestselling and USA Today bestselling author Jack Mars (with over 10,000 five-star reviews). The series begins with EXTRACTION POINT (Book #1).

Former Delta Force operator Clint Hawke is a legendary “cleaner” for the intelligence community, specializing in extracting other operatives from blown covers, failed missions, and the most dangerous of places.

In EXTRACTION RECON (Book #10), Clint and Shaw must extract a whistleblower from a private military corporation's headquarters in Johannesburg by commandeering a helicopter mid-flight. When their extraction is compromised, they must find a way through a dangerous storm while defending against aerial pursuit, pushing their partnership to new heights.

In the Clint Hawke series, heart-pounding action meets razor-sharp tension that grabs you by the throat and never lets go. With breathtaking action sequences and shocking revelations, the series will keep you on the edge of your seat from the explosive first chapter to the stunning conclusion. Perfect for fans of Michael Connelly, David Baldacci, and Brad Thor.

Future books in the series are also available!

“Thriller enthusiasts who relish the precise execution of an international thriller, but who seek the psychological depth and believability of a protagonist who simultaneously fields professional and personal life challenges, will find this a gripping story that's hard to put down.”

--Midwest Book Review, Diane Donovan (regarding Any Means Necessary)
